project.name: ehealthid-relying-party-fork
project.description: Fork of Oviva OIDC Relying Party bridging Germany GesundheitsID (eHealthID) OpenID federation to plain OIDC for the SmokeFree DiGA (used by Keycloak via ehealthid-auth relay). Java 21, in-memory stores, standalone deploy.

nodes.name: Main.java
nodes.summary: Application entry point: bootstraps the standalone OIDC Relying Party server (Undertow + JAX-RS), wires federation client with caching, Caffeine-backed session/code stores, token issuer, key stores, health and Prometheus metrics endpoints. Configured entirely via EHEALTHID_RP_* env vars.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README: this fork is the OIDC Relying Party that bridges Germany GesundheitsID (eHealthID) federation to plain OIDC for our Keycloak. Note the auth flow diagram: IDP redirects to RP, RP handles eHealthID login, IDP redeems the code.

tour.title: Server Entry Point
tour.description: Main.java bootstraps everything: Undertow server, federation client with caching layers, Caffeine session and code stores, token issuer and key stores, health and metrics endpoints. All config comes from EHEALTHID_RP_* env vars.

tour.title: Web Layer (JAX-RS)
tour.description: The ws package exposes the OIDC endpoints: authorization, token, JWKS, OpenID discovery, plus health and Prometheus metrics.

tour.title: Auth Services and Stores
tour.description: The svc package implements the RP core: AuthService drives the flow, TokenIssuerImpl mints tokens, ClientAuthenticator validates clients, Caffeine-backed in-memory repos hold sessions and codes (the in-memory storage noted in the workspace docs).

tour.title: Authentication Flow (library)
tour.description: AuthenticationFlow in the ehealthid library is the heart: trusted federation path, PAR to the sectoral IDP, token exchange for the federated id_token.

tour.title: Federation Client
tour.description: fedclient talks to the GesundheitsID federation master: entity statements, trust chains, IDP list. Cached via CachedFederationApiClient.

tour.title: Crypto
tour.description: JWS verification and JWE decryption utilities used across the federation exchange.

tour.title: CLI Tooling
tour.description: ehealthid-cli generates signing/encryption keys and federation registration XML (cli.sh wraps it). Used once per environment during registration.

tour.title: Build and Deploy
tour.description: Maven multi-module build, Dockerfile for the container image, GitHub workflows with SonarCloud and Spotless. Deployed standalone on the dedicated eHealth box (57.129.22.80), separate from the K8S cluster.
